rows.label: bf01170100_0010
rows.name:
The target supplies are inside a sunken ship
at a depth of 450 melts.

rows.label: bf01170100_0020
rows.name:
Searching the wreck while it's
submerged would be difficult, so...

rows.label: bf01170100_0030
rows.name:
we'll be using flotation devices
and cranes to lift the hull first.

rows.label: bf01170100_0040
rows.name:
Then split into teams and search the interior.
Begin retrieval as soon as you find the target.

rows.label: bf01170100_0050
rows.name:
First, attach the floats.
Get into position.

rows.label: bf01170100_0060
rows.name:
We're paying you a lot,
so make sure you do a good job.
